title: B5: Define directional accuracy for multi-level SAX (level-0 only)
description: Level 0 (approximation): SAX symbols represent trend. Higher symbol = higher value. Direction: predicted > current -> UP, < -> DOWN, = -> HOLD. Detail levels (1-5): oscillation magnitude, NOT price direction — token accuracy only. Implement level0_directional_accuracy() as dedicated metric. Document in ExperimentResult which levels contribute to which metrics. C1-C6 use level-0 only. C7 tests multi-level->direction pipeline. New file: src/wavecast/experiments/metrics.py

title: C7: Ensemble comparison (P1/P2/multi-level/combined)
description: Q7: Does P1+P2 beat either alone? Prereq: validate P1 on real data (3 assets) — if P1 fails, skip ensemble. Method: P1 alone (LSTM+XGB), P2 alone (WaveletGPT level-0), P2 multi-level (all levels->meta-classifier->direction), Combined (P1 features+P2 probs->XGB meta-learner). Error correlation (Pearson). 4 configs (3 if P1 fails). Output: side-by-side accuracy, error corr. Decision: if combined >2% above max(P1,P2) and outside CI overlap, build permanent ensemble.
close_reason: C7 experiment completed: P2 dominates, no ensemble benefit, recommendation=no_benefit

Output: per-regime accuracy+/-CI with sample counts, vs persistence baseline. Decision: if >10% variation, flag regime-conditional models for Phase 4.

title: Implement WaveletGPT — models/wavelet_gpt.py
description: Create src/wavecast/models/wavelet_gpt.py. WaveletGPTNet(nn.Module): token_embed(vocab_size, embed_dim) + pos_embed(context_length, embed_dim) + level_embed(max_levels, embed_dim) + asset_class_embed(n_asset_classes, embed_dim) → sum embeddings → N causal transformer blocks (nn.TransformerEncoderLayer with causal mask) → LayerNorm → Linear(embed_dim, vocab_size) classification head. Weight tying between token_embed and output head. WaveletGPT(BaseModel): fit(X, y, X_val, y_val) trains with CrossEntropyLoss + AdamW + early stopping. predict(X) returns argmax token IDs. predict_proba(X) returns softmax probabilities. save/load with state_dict + config JSON. name='wavelet_gpt'. Config: embed_dim=64, heads=4, layers=3, ~100K-500K params. X columns: [context_tokens..., level_id, asset_class_id]. y: target token ID.
